windows.note: Index is detected from image metadata (EditionId + architecture + language); it is never assumed.

source.help: Fill downloadUrl with the ru-ru x64 consumer ISO link from massgrave.dev (or set localIsoPath to an ISO from https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/software-download/windows11) AND expectedSha256 with the SHA-256 published by Microsoft for that exact file. The build stops if the hash is missing or does not match.

signature.note: 7-Zip installers are not Authenticode-signed by the vendor; integrity relies on SHA-256.

tweaks.name: DisabledByGroupPolicy
tweaks.purpose: Turn off the advertising ID (policy 'Turn off the advertising ID').
tweaks.revert: Delete the value (Settings toggle becomes available again).

tweaks.name: EnableDynamicContentInWSB
tweaks.purpose: Disable search highlights (promoted daily content in Search).
tweaks.revert: Delete the value.

tweaks.name: AllowNewsAndInterests
tweaks.purpose: OPTIONAL (off by default): disable the Widgets board (MSN news feed).
tweaks.revert: Delete the value.

tweaks.name: SilentInstalledAppsEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Stop automatic installation of promoted (suggested) Store apps for new users.
tweaks.revert: Set to 1 or delete the value in HKCU.

tweaks.name: PreInstalledAppsEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Do not provision promoted pre-installed app stubs for new users.
tweaks.revert: Set to 1 or delete the value in HKCU.

tweaks.name: OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Do not provision OEM-promoted app stubs for new users.
tweaks.revert: Set to 1 or delete the value in HKCU.

tweaks.name: SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Disable app suggestions in Start.
tweaks.revert: Set to 1 or delete the value in HKCU.

tweaks.name: SubscribedContent-338388Enabled
tweaks.purpose: Disable occasional suggestions in Start.
tweaks.revert: Set to 1 in HKCU.

tweaks.name: SubscribedContent-338389Enabled
tweaks.purpose: Settings > System > Notifications: 'Get tips and suggestions when using Windows' off.
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: SoftLandingEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Disable 'soft landing' tips notifications.
tweaks.revert: Set to 1 in HKCU.

tweaks.name: SubscribedContent-310093Enabled
tweaks.purpose: Settings > System > Notifications: 'Show the Windows welcome experience after updates' off.
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: SubscribedContent-338393Enabled
tweaks.purpose: Settings > Privacy & security > General: 'Show me suggested content in the Settings app' off (1/3).
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: SubscribedContent-353694Enabled
tweaks.purpose: Suggested content in Settings off (2/3).
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: SubscribedContent-353696Enabled
tweaks.purpose: Suggested content in Settings off (3/3).
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Lock screen: 'Get fun facts, tips, tricks and more' off.
tweaks.revert: Settings > Personalization > Lock screen.

tweaks.name: SubscribedContent-338387Enabled
tweaks.purpose: Lock screen tips content off (pair of the previous setting).
tweaks.revert: Settings > Personalization > Lock screen.

tweaks.name: ScoobeSystemSettingEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Settings > System > Notifications: 'Suggest ways to get the most out of Windows and finish setting up this device' off.
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: Start_IrisRecommendations
tweaks.purpose: Settings > Personalization > Start: 'Show recommendations for tips, shortcuts, new apps, and more' off.
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: Start_AccountNotifications
tweaks.purpose: Settings > Personalization > Start: 'Show account-related notifications' off.
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.

tweaks.name: ShowSyncProviderNotifications
tweaks.purpose: File Explorer: 'Show sync provider notifications' (promotions in Explorer) off.
tweaks.revert: Folder Options > View > re-enable the checkbox.

tweaks.name: TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled
tweaks.purpose: Settings > Privacy & security > General/Diagnostics: 'Tailored experiences' off.
tweaks.revert: Turn the toggle back on in Settings.
